Context: every Minecraft/game server's public connect address is `<subdomain>.<base>` where base comes from ONE global setting `free_minecraft_domain` (default `play.nxeon.cloud`), read via `getSetting("free_minecraft_domain", ...)` or `gameSubdomainBase()` from lib/game-subdomain-dns.ts, or hard-coded as the literal `play.nxeon.cloud`. Rows store only the short name in `Server.subdomain` (paid) and `FreeMinecraftServer.subdomain` (free). We are adding a per-row domain so new servers can live on `playnxeon.com`.

Task: find EVERY place where a game connect address/host is built, displayed, parsed, or where the base domain is passed along (including props named `domain`, `base`, `subdomainBase`, `gameBase`, `freeDomain`, `connectAddress`, `address`), across lib/, worker/, app/, components/, scripts/, tools/nxm/, test/. Include places that build `${x.subdomain}.${something}` strings, places that parse a hostname back into a subdomain (e.g. `endsWith(`.${domain}`)`), SEO/JSON-LD, sitemap (lib/sitemap-sections.ts), emails (grep lib/email*, worker for subdomain), KB/AI-chat facts (lib/kb-*.ts), admin search (app/api/admin/search/route.ts), lib/nx/connect-address.ts, lib/hostname.ts, lib/deploy-intent.ts, lib/order.ts, lib/stripe.ts, lib/actions-gameplans.ts, lib/actions-payment-providers.ts, lib/tours/game.ts, lib/vm-move/*, lib/admin-server/delete-manifest.ts, lib/directory-blocklist-db.ts, app/nxm/**, components/customer/freemc/**, components/admin/FreeMinecraft*.tsx, components/admin/server360/**, app/api/free-minecraft/**.

For each hit output one line: `path:line | what it does (build/display/parse/pass-through/copy text/validation) | which row type (paid Server / free FreeMinecraftServer / both / neither, e.g. marketing copy) | does it have the row available at that point (yes/no) | short code excerpt`. Ignore hosting/NxCloud/Kodely/cold-email/mail subdomains that are unrelated to game servers (but list anything ambiguous). Be exhaustive; it is fine to be long. Also report: how the free directory/public server pages look up a server from a hostname or subdomain URL param (app/(marketing)/servers/[subdomain], app/nxm/servers/[subdomain]), and every place where `Server` or `FreeMinecraftServer` rows are queried with a `select:` that includes `subdomain` (so we know where to add a new `connectDomain` field to the select).
